newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells T-bills worth $38.15 million.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells T-bills worth $38.15 million.

text.p: The Bank of Mauritius sold all 800 million rupees ($38.15 million) worth of T-bills at its weekly auction, the central Bank of Mauritius said on Thursday.
The central bank sold 91-day bills worth 430.0 million rupees at a weighted average yield of 7.94 percent against 143 million rupees at 8.31 percent last week.

The bank sold 182-day bills worth 242 million rupees with an average yield of 8.01 percent, against 96 million rupees at 8.38 percent last week. It sold 364-day bills worth 128 million rupees at an average yield of 8.14 percent, against 211 million rupees at 8.35 percent last week.
This week's effective bank rate was posted at 7.99 percent per annum from 8.34 percent last week, the bank said.
